rule: Each case applies exactly one mutation to a fresh copy of the base fixture.

Render chart-overview.svg at 140 percent of the content-box width without clipping.
Replace one generated table-of-contents page number with the preceding page number.
Remove the required Source Han Sans CN Regular font from the render environment.
Duplicate the paragraph beginning with '分页是最难通过操作序列' during pagination.
Drop the final paragraph of appendix B from the generated PDF.
Force heading '4.3 版本与迁移' to be the last rendered item on a page.
Place heading '5.2 用户为什么仍需裁决' on one page and its first paragraph on the next.
Leave one line of the final appendix B paragraph alone on the following page.
Suppress the repeated header when table 3 crosses a page boundary.
Split the '模型输出破坏内容' row of table 3 across two pages.
Move the caption for chart-process.svg to the next page while leaving the figure behind.
